LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT'S RULING AS TO DEFENDANTS EUGENE SHENKAR'S AND IRMAR CORPORATION'S (DBA OLYMPIC REALTY) DEMURRER TO THE 1ST THRU 10TH CAUSES OF ACTION AND MOTION TO STRIKE THE PRAYER FOR GENERAL DAMAGES IS AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT EUGENE SHENKAR'S DEMURRER: THE DEMURRER IS SUSTAINED WITH 10 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND AS IT RELATES TO SHENKAR ONLY. PLAINTIFFS HAVE LEAVE TO AMEND TO ALLEGE THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN SHENKAR AND OLYMPIC (SEE, FOR EXAMPLE, PARAGRAPHS 4 AND 5V, PARAGRAN 49). DEFENDANT IRMAR CORPORATION'S (DBA OLYMPIC REALTY) DEMURRER: AS TO OLYMPIC, THE DEMURRER TO THE 1ST, 7TH, 8TH, 9TH AND 10TH CAUSES OF ACTION IS OVERRULED. THE DEMURRER IS SUSTAINED AS TO THE 2ND, 3RD AND 6TH CAUSES OF ACTION WITH 10 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND TO ALLEGE WHAT A VISUAL INSPECTION WOULD HAVE SHOWN. THE DEMURRER IS SUSTAINED AS TO THE 4TH AND 5TH CAUSES OF ACTION WITH 10 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND TO ALLEGE THEM WITH SPECIFICITY. JUDGE: JAMES L. WARREN REPORTER: CHRISTINA PAXTON, CSR #1558
